title: Xiaoxi Privacy Policy
excerpt: How local records, on-device recognition, iCloud synchronization, sharing, backups and optional online services handle data.
content:
Updated November 10, 2026. Applies to the Xiaoxi iOS / iPadOS app. Terms for multiple ledgers, sharing and versioned backups apply to versions that provide these features, starting with 1.1.0.

This policy explains how Xiaoxi handles data. We do not use your bookkeeping data for advertising or sell your personal information.

## 1. Local records and recognition

Amounts, categories, accounts, dates, notes, assets, wishlists and custom rules you enter are used for bookkeeping, statistics and management, and are stored in the app's storage on your device. Basic features do not require a Xiaoxi account.

Screenshots, photos and CSV files you select are used for recognition or import. Transaction screenshot recognition runs on the device; recognized content is not sent to third-party AI services. Review results before saving. Import, export and system sharing happen when you choose them. Copies exported to another app or storage service are handled by that service.

## 2. Optional iCloud synchronization

When iCloud synchronization is enabled, app data is stored in your iCloud through Apple CloudKit for synchronization between devices using the same account. It includes transactions, budgets, personal ledgers, assets, wishlists, custom categories and local recognition rules. We do not read your private CloudKit records through developer servers.

iCloud is provided by Apple and requires an Apple account, connectivity and available cloud storage. The system schedules synchronization. Turning off synchronization in the app stops subsequent synchronization on that device; it does not delete data already uploaded. Manage cloud data through Apple's iCloud storage controls.

## 3. Shared ledgers and member information

When you explicitly invite others through iCloud, the shared ledger's name, goals, transactions, budgets, category snapshots and activity history are provided to authorized members. Apple's system sharing interface displays participant identity information according to Apple's mechanisms. Your bookkeeping nickname is used for display and does not replace iCloud authentication.

Each participant needs their own iCloud account. The owner manages membership and permissions. Members with edit access can change all transactions in the shared ledger. Joining a shared ledger does not automatically disclose your unshared personal ledgers, assets, wishlists or complete recognition-rule library.

Leaving or ending sharing may retain a personal copy or the last saved safety copy of shared data. Revocation cannot remove data other members have already exported, captured or copied. Review content and permissions before sharing.

## 4. Versioned iCloud backups

You can save a complete snapshot to your own iCloud. Snapshots contain downloaded ledgers, transactions, budgets, assets, wishlists, custom categories and rules. They may include shared-ledger content you were authorized to download. Other members do not automatically receive your full backup.

Automatic backup is off by default. When enabled, the app checks upon entering the foreground and performs at most one backup per day. It pauses at the retention limit rather than automatically deleting old versions. After changing iCloud accounts, automatic backup must be enabled again.

Restoring shows a preview, requires confirmation and first creates a local rollback backup. It replaces personal data while preserving actively shared ledgers. Shared ledgers from a backup become personal copies. Backups are independent of synchronization: deleting a current transaction does not remove it from historical snapshots. Manage those backups separately.

## 5. Optional online rule and configuration services

The client includes rule and configuration update capabilities. Requests are sent only when a valid online service is configured; otherwise local rules continue to work. Requests may include a random installation identifier, app and build versions, platform, release channel and rule version for compatibility, staged updates and service diagnostics. The installation identifier is not an advertising identifier and is not used for cross-app advertising tracking. These update requests do not contain transaction text, amounts or screenshots.

Network services may generate connection logs needed to handle requests and operate securely. Apple handles system iCloud services under its policies.

## 6. System permissions

Voice input uses Apple's speech-recognition framework. Depending on the system, language and device, recognition may be processed by Apple's online services and is not always performed on the device. Follow the system authorization prompt when deciding whether to use it. Recognized text becomes a draft entry for your review.

Photo-library, speech-recognition, microphone and notification permissions are requested by the system when corresponding features need them; prompts depend on features used and system version. You may revoke permissions in Settings. Related features may then be unavailable, but existing local records are not automatically deleted. The app does not request location permission or use advertising-tracking frameworks to track you.

## 7. Retention, deletion and protection

Local data remains until actions such as deletion in the app, replacement during a restore or uninstallation. Trash, historical versions, exports, local rollback backups and iCloud versioned backups can hold separate copies and must be managed separately. Uninstalling does not delete iCloud data or other members' copies.

We use system app sandboxing, storage permissions and CloudKit transport mechanisms to protect data. Protect your device and Apple account. You can access, edit and export your records, and use app and system controls to delete local or cloud data. Shared records also involve other members' permissions and retained copies.

## 8. Website, feedback and contact

This website is hosted on the cloudmantou blog. Public product, privacy and support pages can be read without registration. Blog login, comments and feedback are also covered by the [cloudmantou website privacy policy](https://cloudmantoua.top/privacy). Do not post complete statements, identity documents, bank-card numbers or other sensitive material in public comments.

Provide only the information needed to handle a support issue. Contact modianwuhen@gmail.com for privacy questions, corrections or deletion requests. We may need to reasonably verify that a request concerns your data, but will not ask for your Apple-account password.

Changes to this policy will be posted here with an updated date.
